ground_snap.label: Ground Altitude Lock
ground_snap.description: Constrains the camera focus altitude to the actual terrain height while panning.

through.label: Pass through
through.description: The camera goes wherever the controls put it. Underground there are no inward-facing faces, so the scene reads inside out.

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: Zoom, rotate and tilt go as far as they asked or as far as they can. Nothing moves on its own.

climb.label: Climb over
climb.description: Zoom always takes effect and the view pitches up to clear the ground instead. Every zoom level stays reachable, at the cost of an angle you did not set.

show_shadow_map.label: Shadows
show_shadow_map.description: The sun casts shadows from terrain, objects and characters onto the ground.

msaa.label: Anti-aliasing (MSAA)
msaa.description: Smooths the edges of far-away blocks by sampling each pixel four times. Costs a lot of graphics memory.

show_debug_objects.label: Debug Gizmos
show_debug_objects.description: Displays coordinate markers (map centers, tile boundaries) for debugging purposes.

show_ledger.label: Scheduler Ledger
show_ledger.description: Corner panel showing frame pacing, GPU load, fetch-queue depth and task latency from the world scheduler, with the report, trace and console-log buttons.

enable_terrain_carving.label: Terrain Carving
enable_terrain_carving.description: Lets the eraser dig into the real terrain itself, one voxel at a time, when nothing is placed there.
